qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the plug in rear casing section on all transmission types?
What torque should be applied to the sealing caps on rear case section for 240/260/280 transmissions?
What is the torque specification for the reversing bolt to reversing lever?
qa_pairs.answer: 43 Nm using ZF S-5-16/S 5 D 310 Z screw type.

qa_pairs.question: Which transmission types use M16 screws for the plug in rear casing section?
qa_pairs.answer: The 240 transmission type uses M16 screws.

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between the plug in rear casing section for 240 vs 260/280 transmissions?
qa_pairs.answer: Both 240 and 260/280 transmissions require 60 Nm, but 240 uses M16 screws while 260/280 uses M22 screws.

qa_pairs.question: Which components in section 23 11 use the ZF S-5-16/S 5 D 310 Z screw type?
qa_pairs.answer: The reversing bolt to reversing lever, clamping claws to rear case section, and screws on detent plate all use ZF S-5-16/S 5 D 310 Z screw type.

qa_pairs.question: What screw size is used for the plug in rear casing section on 260/280 transmission types?
qa_pairs.answer: M22 screw size is used for 260/280 transmission types.
